column1: #  partitions.csv  —  tuned OTA layout for the Museum Hub (4 MB flash)
#  Why a custom table instead of the Arduino "default.csv"?
#    - default.csv: app0/app1 = 1.25 MiB each. Linked use is 955
#      leaving thin headroom to grow before an OTA upload fails as "too big".
#  This table rebalances: each OTA app slot = 1.5 MiB (linked use 60.7%; the
#  LittleFS = 896 KiB (web bundle + scratch + normal ~2 KB QVGA gallery)
#  with zero gaps so no flash is wasted. Nothing runs out of room
#  Switching layouts is a ONE-TIME full reflash over USB:
#     pio run -e hub -t erase && pio run -e hub -t upload && pio run -e hub -t uploadfs

column2: every update goes over the air:  pio run -e hub-ota -t upload
